BiblicalUsage: The Cushite woman appears once, and she is the cause of the quarrel in Numbers 12:1: "Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married." The text gives her no name and no words of her own, only the fact of the marriage and the complaint it drew.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure her silence in the text is itself the rebuke: Miriam and Aaron judged a marriage God had not condemned, and the leprosy fell on the accuser, not on the wife.
